question: Can a fixed decoder distinguish the two cued imagery tasks in participants absent from every fitting and selection step

preprocessing.reference: Common average over the 27 EEG channels before selecting nine channels
preprocessing.demean: Per channel within each completed epoch
preprocessing.normalisation: One RMS across all nine channels and all samples in each filtered epoch
preprocessing.trial_rejection: No amplitude or outcome based rejection; invalid files, missing channels, nonfinite signals, absent classes or incomplete epochs stop the run for investigation

models.scaler: StandardScaler fitted only on training participants
models.training_weight: For each trial: training trial count divided by twice the number of training participants times the number of training trials for that participant and class
models.selection: Highest validation participant mean balanced accuracy; exact ties favour bandpower; no refitting on validation people

primary.target: The selected model has a test participant bootstrap 95% interval with lower bound strictly above 0.50
primary.interpretation: Discrimination of the two cued tasks in this previously unseen participant sample, conditional on the fitted model and source cohort composition

selective_prediction.choose: Lowest threshold satisfying all requirements on validation participants for each model
selective_prediction.interpretation: Secondary empirical operating rule, not a reliability guarantee; raw logistic scores are not recalibrated

execution.fit_stage: Read training and validation participants only, fit both fixed models, save validation predictions, model hashes and selection
execution.selection_seal: Commit selection.json before accessing final participant EEG or final outcomes
execution.test_stage: Verify committed selection, protocol, model and executable source hashes, then evaluate all test participants once
execution.stopping_rule: Publish both model results and all participant results regardless of whether either target is met; never retune or replace test people after inspection

limitations: Cued imagery and sham feedback may contain visual responses and artefacts; delaying the epoch does not prove that those effects are removed
The first two acquisition runs use sham feedback rather than no feedback
No instructed rest or continuous command evaluation is included in this trial study
The fitted models differ from the deployed PhysioNet CNN and do not externally validate that CNN
Only two test participants come from cohort C; its individual scores are descriptive
Intervals describe these fitted models and sampled cohorts, not uncertainty across repeated training or different headsets
Participants with source missing trials are retained with their available trials; identities and partitions are never replenished
